csv_project_name: Design for Lynwood Center Roadway Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: This project will provide non-motorized improvements on Lynwood Center Road between Fletcher Bay Road and Baker Hill Road. Improvements could include physically or vertically separated paths on one or both sides of the road. The City of Bainbridge Island seeks qualifications from transportation engineering design firms to support the Lynwood Center Road Non-Motorized Improvements Project, including conceptual design evaluation, final conceptual planning, easement acquisition support, 30/60/100% design plans, specifications, estimates, and limited construction administration support.
